warnings.headline: Status Yellow - Wind and Rain warning for Cork, Kerry, Waterford
warnings.description:
Strong and gusty southeastly winds, veering southwesterly with heavy spells of rain at times. 

Be aware of potential impacts:

  • Difficult travelling conditions
  • Localised flooding possible
  • Poor visibility
  • Debris, loose objects displaced
